The current goes from the upper left side through the upper bulb L1, and then reaches the upper right node; from this node downward it divides into two parallel branches: the middle branch is connected in sequence with ammeter A1 and bulb L2, and the right branch is connected in sequence with ammeter A2 and bulb L3. The lower ends of the two branches are then connected back to the lower wire. Reasoning: The phenomena given in the question stem are that L1 lights up, L2 and L3 do not light up, A1 has a reading, A2 has no reading, and there is only one fault. A1 having a reading indicates that current passes through the middle branch, so the middle branch is not an open circuit, and the main circuit also has current, therefore L1 can light up. A2 having no reading and L3 not lighting up indicate that the right branch has no current. If L2 is short-circuited, then the middle branch almost becomes a low-resistance path, causing the voltage across the two ends of the parallel part to be shorted, and the two ends of the right branch A2 and L3 have almost no voltage, so A2 has no reading and L3 does not light up; at the same time, the main circuit and the middle branch still have current, so L1 lights up and A1 has a reading, while L2 does not light up because it is short-circuited. This situation is consistent with all the phenomena, and only one fault is needed.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出电路结构：左侧电源后，L1在干路上；经过L1后分成两条并联支路，中间支路为A1与L2串联，右侧支路为A2与L3串联。再读取题干现象：L1发光，L2、L3不亮，A1有读数，A2没有读数，且只有一处故障。推理时逐项排除：A1有读数说明中间支路有电流通过，所以中间支路不是断路，且干路也有电流，因此L1能亮；A2无读数且L3不亮说明右支路没有电流。若L2短路，则中间支路近似成为一条低电阻通路，使并联部分两端电压被短接，右支路A2、L3两端几乎无电压，因此A2无读数、L3不亮；同时干路仍有电流，所以L1亮，A1有读数，而L2因被短接不发光。该现象完全吻合且只需一处故障，故故障为L2短路。
